reading.body:
QTS Data Center - Hillsboro 1 in Hillsboro, Oregon, publishes 20 MW of IT capacity, operated by Quality Technology Services.

At 10 kW per rack, a common enterprise colocation density, that load supports roughly 2000 racks. At 40 kW per rack, a density closer to AI training workloads, it supports roughly 500 racks. The operator has not published a per-rack power envelope, so neither figure is the operator's own claim, only what the published megawattage implies under each assumption.

No compliance certifications are published for QTS Data Center - Hillsboro 1. That does not mean none exist, only that this site's dataset, built from the operator's own facility page, does not list any, which limits what regulated workloads a reader could confirm the facility is qualified to host.

Oregon has 15 facilities mapped in this site's dataset, of which 8 publish a megawatt figure, totaling 192.6 MW. QTS Data Center - Hillsboro 1 contributes 20 MW of that total. That is a meaningful facility by colocation standards, though still below the scale where frontier AI training clusters typically operate.
